name: The Three Martyrs: St Sebastian, St Boniface and St Thomas of Canterbury, Salford
shortName: The Three Martyrs: St Sebastian, St Boniface and St Thomas of Canterbury

boundary.description: From the junction of Bury Old Road and Singleton Road, E along Bury Old Road, Waterloo Road, S along Bury New Road and Sherborne Steet West to the end of the road and by a beeline to and W along River Irwell to the point opposite the junction of University Road and Wallness Lane. Then W by the University Road to the railway, and by Salford Crescent – Swinton railway to the point opposite the junction of Barfield Road and Bolton Road and by a beeline N to the Salford Crescent – Clifton railway. By that railway to and E along Agecroft Road to and S along River Irwell to the point opposite Regatta Street. By a beeline NE to and along South Radford Street, Kingsley Avenue and by a beeline to the River Irwell. E along the River Irwell to the point opposite the junction of Bury New Road and Broom Lane. N along Bury New Road, Park Lane and Singleton Road to its junction with Bury Old Road.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Thomas of Canterbury and St Sebastian and St Boniface
internalBoundaries.description: From the junction of Bury New Road and Broughton Lane along Broughton Lane, Great Clowes Street and the Priory to its junction with Lower Broughton Road. Then by a beeline W to the River Irwell, and N along the river to the point opposite the junction of Bury New Road and Broom Lane.
